ranked_passages.difficulty: The MT/OSHB samekh after 26:2 and explicit אם protasis at 26:3 support a seam, but 26:1-2 is a very short allegiance frame inside one uninterrupted Sinai speech.
ranked_passages.translation_issue: מֹטֹת עֻלְּכֶם and קוֹמְמִיּוּת at 26:13 vary across English renderings but do not decide the seam.
ranked_passages.candidate_treatment: Retain both children; withhold 061a from standalone retrieval pending human/external-AI decision.

ranked_passages.difficulty: English and Hebrew numbering diverge across a live offering-case boundary and can attach Hebrew evidence to the wrong verses.
ranked_passages.translation_issue: WEB 6:1-7 = MT/OSHB 5:20-26; WEB 6:8-30 = MT/OSHB 6:1-23; resynchronization occurs at 7:1.
ranked_passages.candidate_treatment: Retain boundaries with mandatory explicit versification labels; numbering is not boundary authority.

ranked_passages.difficulty: Lev.7.7 changes from a reparation procedure to comparative cross-offering allocations, yet explicitly links offerings and has no MT/OSHB break before it.
ranked_passages.translation_issue: חטאת and אשם may be rendered sin/guilt or purification/reparation offering; English gloss choice must not create the seam.
ranked_passages.candidate_treatment: Two parent-dependent children; preserve the defensible unsplit reading as residual dissent.

ranked_passages.difficulty: Death-framed access, ordered sanctuary rites, and annual statute are locally distinct but mutually dependent parts of one ritual complex.
ranked_passages.translation_issue: Ritual labels and goat terminology are evidence cues, not automatic seams.
ranked_passages.candidate_treatment: Retain three retrieval children only under the mandatory 16:1-34 parent.

ranked_passages.difficulty: Lev.18:24-30 is grammatically backward-dependent, while Lev.20 supplies corresponding sanctions and Lev.19 remains a distinct communal address.
ranked_passages.translation_issue: Anaphoric בכל־אלה and land-expulsion language require Hebrew-context reading without importing modern categories.
ranked_passages.candidate_treatment: Retain functional children with mandatory Lev.18 parent and non-hierarchical Lev.18-to-20 relation.

ranked_passages.difficulty: Verse 15 begins a carrion/washing/temporary-impurity case after blood and hunted-game rules, but a two-verse output child would over-fragment the speech.
ranked_passages.translation_issue: נבלה and טרפה terminology should remain distinct from blood/life rationale in sidecars.
ranked_passages.candidate_treatment: Retain one low-confidence chunk with an explicit 17:15 internal seam.

ranked_passages.difficulty: The repeated אלה מועדי heading at 23:4 shifts from weekly Sabbath to the dated annual calendar, while both remain inside one appointed-times corpus.
ranked_passages.translation_issue: מועדים is better tracked as appointed times than treated narrowly as feasts; the gloss does not govern the boundary.
ranked_passages.candidate_treatment: Retain two short but complete children under the calendar parent.

ranked_passages.difficulty: Two complete divine speeches govern adjacent seventh-month observances with different dates, sanctions, and dependencies.
ranked_passages.translation_issue: זכרון תרועה and ענה נפש admit varied English renderings without weakening the speech boundary.
ranked_passages.candidate_treatment: Retain two linked children with calendar and seventh-month parents.

ranked_passages.difficulty: Repeated diagnostic, isolation, reinspection, cleansing, and summary formulas create nested procedures across persons, garments, and houses.
ranked_passages.translation_issue: צרעת labels a textual diagnostic category whose English medical equivalents can falsely imply modern diagnoses.
ranked_passages.candidate_treatment: Retain medium-sized procedural units; do not split mechanically at every diagnostic condition.

ranked_passages.difficulty: Multiple male and female discharge cases share washing, timing, offering, sanctuary-risk, and summary logic but contain plausible case seams.
ranked_passages.translation_issue: Bodily-condition vocabulary is translation-sensitive and must not be mapped uncritically to modern diagnoses.
ranked_passages.candidate_treatment: Retain the larger low-confidence case collection with an internal case map.

ranked_passages.difficulty: One uninterrupted Mount Sinai speech spans land rest, Jubilee, redemption, service, allegiance, blessings, sanctions, restoration, and a corpus colophon.
ranked_passages.translation_issue: עבד, אמה, גר, תושב, and פרך can create false English social-case boundaries.
ranked_passages.candidate_treatment: Retain functional children only with the mandatory whole-speech relation.

ranked_passages.difficulty: Escalating sanctions, exile, confession, land recovery, covenant remembrance, and colophon form a graded discourse with a strong restoration transition at 26:40.
ranked_passages.translation_issue: קרי is obscure and variously rendered contrary, hostile, or by chance; the uncertainty must not manufacture seams.
ranked_passages.candidate_treatment: Retain sanctions and restoration/colophon children with graded-discourse parent relation.

ranked_passages.difficulty: Firstborn and irrevocably devoted exceptions, tithes, and the final colophon shift functions inside the book's closing speech.
ranked_passages.translation_issue: חרם has lexical and ethical ambiguity that cannot be resolved from unavailable ANE or rabbinic evidence.
ranked_passages.candidate_treatment: Retain two low/medium-low children with internal exception/tithe/colophon maps.

ranked_passages.difficulty: Offense, custody, divine ruling, generalized equal-law material, and execution are distinguishable but form one complete case-ruling-performance envelope.
ranked_passages.translation_issue: נקב and קלל require caution around blaspheming, cursing, or pronouncing the Name.
ranked_passages.candidate_treatment: Retain as one medium-confidence narrative-legal unit.

ranked_passages.difficulty: Mixture rule, pledged-servant case, fruit-year procedure, divination/body practices, and exploitation warning form a deliberately heterogeneous legal list.
ranked_passages.translation_issue: Legal-function and status terminology vary, but translation differences are cues rather than boundaries.
ranked_passages.candidate_treatment: Retain low-confidence parent with explicit four-part internal map.

external_corpus_gap: No reviewed local ANE, Second Temple, ancient Jewish, rabbinic, Mishnah, Talmud, Midrash, Sifra, Philo, or Josephus corpus was available; no claim from those corpora is simulated.
